basics.ugc: UGC-recognised; programmes approved by AICTE, PCI, BCI and NCTE
basics.other: Engineering (including B.Tech ECE with L&T), computer applications, business, pharmacy, health sciences, agriculture and more

admission: Class 12 with Physics, Maths and Chemistry/Biology/Computer Science and English; 55% in the three subjects (50% reserved)
Q-CARE (Quantum's entrance-cum-scholarship exam), JEE Main, UKSEE, CUET UG or Class 12 merit
CAT, CMAT, MAT, XAT or NMAT scores preferred

scholarships.text: Scholarships of up to 100% on tuition through Q-CARE, with scholarships on JEE Main and CUET scores.

hostel.text: On-campus hostels with AC and non-AC options.

fees.text: First-year fee for B.Tech (Hons.) CSE in 2026 is ₹1,64,500 for Uttarakhand domicile students and ₹1,69,500 for others, plus a one-time ₹5,000 registration charge.
